title: CustomEmojiCard::Asked is settled only by the card render; no timeout or owner-gone exit
trigger: Tap a custom emoji (Asked{request}), then the reply never arrives or the chat/pane is left before a render that builds the card
effect: Asked stays set and the answer sits in session.stickers.custom_emoji_answers; a later render can pop the card in an unrelated chat
fix: Clear Asked when the tapped chat closes or the account changes, and drain custom_emoji_answers from the poll rather than from render

title: dismissed_keyboards and collapsed_keyboards are append-only sets keyed by ChatMessage that nothing prunes
trigger: Press a one-time keyboard button or toggle the keyboard collapse in many chats over a long session
effect: Sets grow for the life of the window; dismissed state is also kept when deleteChatReplyMarkup failed (local hide stands, never retried)
fix: Hold the keyboard stage (Shown/Collapsed/Dismissed) on the chat's ChatUi next to the reply markup so it dies with the chat, and keep the delete request id in the stage

title: Invite preview kept twice: the session's DeepLinkState::InvitePreview and screen.links.invite_box.request()
trigger: Open an invite link, then click another link while the box is up
effect: Two owners of one stage are kept in step by hand (take(), end_deep_link_flow, cancel_deep_link_invite); today every path clears both
fix: Make the box a view of the flow stage (derive is_open from deep_link_stage) instead of storing the request again

title: hold_resolved_link overwrites an unconsumed ResolvedLink
trigger: Two typed links resolve before the frame that runs the first (window minimized, locked)
effect: The first resolved link is dropped silently; only the newest runs
fix: A queue of resolved steps, or an explicit Replaced note
